presentation.label: SCORCH
presentation.summary: An aggressive high-gain amp with its cab built in: one Gain knob from crunch to a wall of distortion.
presentation.overview: Scorch is a high-gain amp and cab in one effect: a tight high-pass before cascaded asymmetric clipping stages with filtering between them, a scooped tone stack, and a 4x12-style cab baked in as filters. Gain sets the distortion, and Mix blends it with your dry signal.
highlights: Cascaded clipping stages for tight high gain
Tone stack and cab built in
Mix blends it with your dry signal
usage: Put Scorch in a patch and turn Mix up to 100.
Raise Gain from crunch to full high gain.
Lower Mix to blend your dry signal back in.

access.location: The pedal's effect list, Delay group, as Scorch.
steps: Add Scorch to a patch from the effect list (Delay group).
Its knobs are on the effect's pages, three per page.

controls.name: Gain
controls.doc: Preamp gain: the amount of distortion.

limitations: Built with the init path off: a recalled patch plays the knobs' defaults until you touch a knob.

load.conditions: The cost Scorch declares in its descriptor, which the pedal adds up per patch; not read from the DSP meter.

hardware.summary: The release file was on the pedal (read back over USB with the same SHA-256): the pedal booted, the effect showed its screen and did its job.
limitations: One run, reported by the tester as working; nothing measured.
Built with the init path off: the sound takes saved knob values only once a knob is touched.
MIDISTOMP V2.0.1 on Zoom's 2.10, not Zoom's 2.10 alone.

tests.summary: The release file has no code from Zoom's effects (check_no_stock.py), passes Ziddle's loader check, renders in Ziddle, and ran on an MS-70CDR.
